version.changelog:
- Removed the redundant skill-card.md file for better project organization.
- No changes to functionality or security; all endpoints and usage remain the same.
- Documentation and API usage unaffected.

llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed market-data integration that can manage mkts.io portfolio, journal, and watchlist records only with explicit user confirmation.

dimensions.detail: The skill uses network calls to an external financial service and can transmit sensitive financial records, but this is disclosed and tied to the stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a single non-executable SKILL.md requiring only curl and an optional MKTS_API_KEY environment variable; no install scripts or hidden setup behavior were present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill repeatedly instructs agents to default to read-only behavior, show exact payloads before mutations, resolve IDs before deletion, and treat external content as untrusted.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Authenticated writes can persist portfolio holdings, journal entries, watchlists, and optional registration data to mkts.io, with clear confirmation and deletion safeguards documented.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The advertised purpose matches the artifact: market data retrieval plus optional authenticated portfolio, journal, and watchlist workflows through mkts.io.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable sending market queries and, when authenticated, portfolio, journal, and watchlist data to mkts.io. Keep MKTS_API_KEY private and require the agent to show exact payloads before any create, update, delete, registration, or portfolio-card write operation.
